headers.X-MS-Booking: optional, redemption id for a booked slot

notes: Response is an illustrative contract shape, not a stored runtime answer.
Live rates come from GET /catalog/gpus. Missing or stale rates fail with PRICING_UNAVAILABLE before execution.
The metered charge is hourly rate times measured endpoint request runtime divided by 3600.
An active reservation belonging to X-MS-Buyer has charge 0.000000 and charge_basis prepaid_booking. Missing, expired or wrong-owner reservations return BOOKING_NOT_FOUND.
The API task router owns payment settlement. This service reports metered usage.
